fields.name: Visuals
fields.evidence: GameEngine.dll+0x8B11F0 (Toolkit, ls::SoundMaterialSystem::ProcessClusterVisuals) addresses the component with stride 0xB8 (=184, the registry size); it looks up an EntityHandle in the map at +0 (buckets +8, keys +0x20/+0x2C) and reads the value at *(+0x30) + index*8, IndexedStorage<ls::ClusterVisualData, s_TagCluster> assert: 8-byte ls::ClusterVisualData values, dereferenced as an object pointer. Live: HashMap shape with values.

fields.name: field_40_Keys
fields.evidence: Second HashMap: live samples show bucket count at +0x48, cap/size pairs at +0x58/+0x68 and value storage at +0x70/+0x78; value type not established. Key part of a ls::HashMap (buckets +0, NextIds +0x10, Keys +0x20).

fields.name: field_40_Values
fields.evidence: Value storage of the same HashMap (likely uint32_t as in ClusterPhysicsAlwaysLoadedComponent+0x40); element size not established, so spelled out as raw parts.

fields.name: field_40_ValueCapacity
fields.evidence: Value storage capacity of the same HashMap (live: equals the key capacity).

fields.name: _Pad7C
fields.evidence: Padding of the value storage (always 0 live).

fields.name: Frame
fields.evidence: GameEngine.dll+0xA0B900 compares *(int*)(this+0x80) with the current frame index (param_2+0x10), stores the new one and then empties the ModifiedPair list (+0x94 = 0) and the arrays at +0x98/+0xA8. Live: 0x36D..0x9FA0.

fields.name: field_84
fields.evidence: Not read by the code seen; live values vary (0..0xFFFFFFFF), maybe uninitialised padding.

fields.name: ModifiedPairs
fields.evidence: GameEngine.dll+0xA0B900 walks +0x88 with capacity +0x90 and size +0x94 under the assert IndexedStorage<ls::ClusterVisualLoadedComponent::ModifiedPair>; GameEngine.dll+0x6F42E0 reallocates it with 0x10-byte, 8-aligned elements (16-byte ModifiedPair). Live: capacity 0/0x20, size 0/0x12.

fields.name: Added
fields.evidence: GameEngine.dll+0xA0B900 clears +0x98 each new frame; SoundMaterialSystem::ProcessClusterVisuals ('LatestClusterAdded') walks *(+0x98) up to the count at +0xA4, stride 8, dereferencing each element as an object (reads +0x108) - ls::ClusterVisualData pointers. Live: empty.

fields.name: Removed
fields.evidence: GameEngine.dll+0xA0B900 clears +0xA8 together with +0x98; the physics twin (GameEngine.dll+0x120E90) pushes ClusterPhysicsData into +0x98 on add and into +0xA8 when replacing/removing. Name inferred. Live: empty.

summary: Client visual streaming: the visuals of a loaded cluster, keyed by the source entity (HashMap<EntityHandle, ClusterVisualData*>), with a second map, a frame stamp, the per-frame ModifiedPair list and per-frame added/removed lists that ls::SoundMaterialSystem and ls::SceneSystem consume. Added by ls::ClusterVisualLoaderSystem when a cluster's visuals finish loading; on cluster entities of idle levels.
